Experimental. A VLAN on a Juniper EX or QFX switch running ELS, by name, and its ID. Interfaces and descriptions on it are left alone.

**Experimental.** Network devices are new, and this module may change between releases. It's tested against vJunos-switch 26.2R1.7 on a lab VM, not yet in CI.

Use `junos_vlan` to create a VLAN on a Juniper EX or QFX switch running ELS, and give it an ID. Junos keys VLANs by name, so the name is what the step owns, and changing `vlan_id` updates it in place. Only the ID is owned: interfaces and a description you add elsewhere are left alone. Removing the step deletes the VLAN, everything under it included, unless `on_remove = "forget"`. The change goes in like every Junos step does; see [`junos_config`](/modules/junos_config).

## Example usage

```hcl
step "users" {
  junos_vlan {
    name    = "users"
    vlan_id = 10
  }
}
```

One step per VLAN, from a map:

```hcl
step "vlans" {
  for_each = { users = 10, voice = 20, iot = 30 }

  junos_vlan {
    name    = item.key
    vlan_id = item.value
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | VLAN name, as Junos keys VLANs, such as users. It starts with a letter. |
| `on_remove` | string | No | What happens on the device when this resource is removed: "delete" (default) deletes the VLAN, everything under it included; "forget" leaves it. |
| `vlan_id` | number | Yes | VLAN ID, 1 to 4094. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_junos_vlan.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the VLAN was there with this ID at the last refresh. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_junos_vlan` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
